reference_policy: Project screenshots inspected by Codex, translated into composition constraints; no outside art references supplied.
common_prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup / stylized-concept. Create ONE original finished pixel-art art-direction keyframe for Rail Link: Collapse. Portrait canvas aspect 390:844, ideally 780x1688 or equivalent. No sheet, no alternatives, no title or watermark. This is an actual game screen concept, not a poster.
Camera is ahead of the locomotive looking back at its FRONT, elevated just enough to see the boiler top. Locomotive enters a gentle turn toward screen-left; show round front AND its long right side with THREE large connected wheels, cab and side piston. Engine occupies x100..285 y180..365 of a 390x844 layout, large like a close camera x2. Tracks in foreground occupy y365..720. Three distinct rail lanes, selected center lane curves gently left beneath the engine; two visible neighboring lanes. Engine wheels sit on rails. Nothing blocks route visibility.
Behind cab and above engine, the SAME brick tunnel and track bed progressively collapse into magma in FOUR overlapping depth layers: distant dark broken arch, nearer tilted brick pier, sinking ballast shelf with bent rails, intact ground under engine. Bricks, ballast, sleepers and rails continue from whole into broken without a horizontal seam or a separate backdrop slab. Some broken rails hang down into magma. No intact wall of flame; broad near-black gaps between destruction masses. A small finite gap on foreground right-hand lane reveals lava; center chosen route intact. Foreground must remain quiet and readable with restrained sparse ballast marks, not visual noise.
Original industrial gothic steam locomotive instrument panel: black cast iron, substantial silhouettes, thin brass rims, rivets only at structural corners, custom blocky cream NUMERALS, pictograms, brass analog gauges. Top strip y0..70 includes small wheel/track distance icon and 5985, a smaller trophy-shaped icon and 0, and pause symbol as two vertical strokes. Bottom strip y722..844 contains THREE clearly distinct counters: cartridge pictogram with 8, shield pictogram with 0, rescue hook pictogram with 0, plus a weathered original engineer portrait with cap, heavy eyebrow and square moustache. Analog gauge uses ticks and needle without letters. Exactly these numbers 5985, 0, 8, 0, 0; no words, letters, unit abbreviations, runes or logos anywhere. Include a single green double-chevron switch marker on center route near y600, readable but small. No faux text texture.
Pixel-art method: designed at approximately 166x360 logical pixels, large clean hand-placed pixel clusters, consistent pixels across world and interface, stepped silhouettes, sparse detail concentrated on locomotive, broken edge and engineer face. Flat material ramps with 3 or 4 tones, no airbrush, gradients, bloom, antialias, photographic texture or dithering noise. Mostly quiet dark masses, highlights on brass and rail edges; emissive yellow limited to headlamp and lava sources. One artist's visual language for brick, vault, cliffs, iron and train. Original design; do not reference or copy any existing game, UI or character.
Use ONLY these palette colors: #0b0a10 #17121b #241a24 #33232b #47303a #3a1010 #5c3a35 #7a4a3a #96604a #b07a58 #cc9c74 #e8d0a8 #6a1410 #9c1e10 #d2340f #f0601a #f8902a #fcc048 #fff090 #2a3038 #465058 #6c7880 #9aa8ac #d0d8d4 #1f5a30 #2f9a44 #6cdc5c #1f4a8c #3a8ae0 #8cd4f0 #5a2a78 #fff8ec.

VARIANT 01: Furnace ribs. Broad rounded brick barrel vault and three massive rusted iron ribs; warm dark oxblood brick and very dark plum shadows. Collapsing pier on upper right slopes down into broken rail bed, interlocking with the intact platform. Restrained warm brass engine, black large boiler. Bottom instrument panel has a central round brass-framed engineer portrait, left large analog dial with the cartridge count, right two smaller recessed resource windows. Heavy slab-like top panel, squared shoulders and a small pointed central crest. Human-designed restrained layout, strongest warm/cool silhouette separation.

VARIANT 02: Foundry arcade. Low segmental brick arches on very thick angular steel buttresses, large soot-dark blue-grey iron planes and rusty red brick infill, not a cathedral. Strong asymmetric arch falling from upper left into a staggered series of shelves on the right; clearly continuous tracks bend into that destruction behind train. Broad simple engine side in muted blue-grey with warm brass trim. Bottom dashboard is an asymmetric workshop casting: square engineer portrait at lower left, large round gauge to its right, three neatly separated brass-rimmed resource windows across the remaining panel. Top panel has a central mechanical distance odometer and small round pause housing right. Fewer decorative marks, strongest clean silhouettes and spacious quiet road.
CRITICAL LAYOUT: the train must be in UPPER THIRD, its front bumper at 42 percent of total screen height; keep its width about 45 percent of screen width. Bottom half of scene is visibly long foreground tracks. The train is seen from above in three-quarter front view, NOT a dramatic low-angle poster. HUD bottom occupies at most 14 percent of screen height. Make architecture large quiet clusters, no fine stone grain.

VARIANT 03: Deep vault. Tall pointed brick arches with massive buttresses, broad muted plum/brown masonry shadows, restrained copper/brass catches; original industrial gothic, not fantasy carved ornament. Four staggered collapsing arches form a dark zigzag behind the locomotive; three pieces of bent rail visibly sink at different depths into a narrow magma channel. Engine has bold almost-black boiler, large brown side panels and restrained brass. Bottom dashboard is symmetrical with two large brass circular gauges flanking a small rectangular engineer portrait centered below the gauges; three resource counters are recessed along the bottom lip, their icons directly beside numbers. Top panel a shallow stepped iron lintel with distance window left and pause right. Architectural framing dominates the edges but leaves the foreground quiet.
CRITICAL LAYOUT: elevated three-quarter FRONT camera, engine front bumper at y350 of 844, locomotive width 200 of390; bottom half is long approaching rails. Center track gently curves left underneath locomotive, green double-chevron indicates LEFT along this curve. Right lane has a finite gap, its rails resume beyond gap. Bottom panel is only 120 of844 tall. Prioritize broad calm arch-shadow shapes and uninterrupted dark foreground ballast; detail only engine and collapse lip. Keep whole scene compact pixel clusters, clear stepped lighting, no painterly texture.
